lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 10-15 remoras (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in the water column directly beneath the shark's ventral surface.
